verses.1: In You, LORD, I take refuge forever.
verses.2: In your righteousness, save me and deliver me from this terrible situation. Listen to my prayers and save me.
verses.3: May there be a way for me to come back always. You have always commanded me to save me, for I am your rock and you are my refuge.
verses.4: The evil one has taken me by force from my own people, from those who are righteous and holy.
verses.5: For you are my prayer, O LORD Jehovah, from my youth.
verses.6: I have been bound to your feet from my mother’s side. You are a godly person; my songs will always be in your honor.
verses.7: I was like a burden to many people, but you are my safe haven.
verses.8: May my mouth be filled with your praises every day.
verses.9: Do not abandon me in my old age, just as you did with all my strength. Do not leave me behind.
verses.10: For they said, “Oh my friends, I will protect my soul.” They advised me together.
verses.11: And they said, “God has abandoned him; they will pursue and capture him, for there is no one who can save him.”
verses.12: God, do not distance yourself from me. O God, please be my helper.
verses.13: May they be punished; may the wicked of the soul suffer disgrace and shame. May all those who seek my harm be destroyed.
verses.14: And I will always be concerned and attentive to all your words.
verses.15: I will recount your righteousness all day long; your salvation will be known forever. For I do not know how many times you have been saved.
verses.16: I will come in great glory, O God of Israel. Then I will remember your righteousness only for yourself.
verses.17: God has taught me from my youth, and until now I will always speak of your wonders.
verses.18: And even in old age, and when I’m gone, God will not let me be left alone. He will make my descendants live for generations to come, as a sign of Your greatness.
verses.19: And your righteousness, O God, is beyond all praise. You have done great things, O God! Who else can compare to you?
verses.20: May they see that I suffer great hardships and evils. May the destruction of my life be reversed, and may the land be restored to its former state.
verses.21: Let my greatness increase, and let me be comforted.
verses.22: I also adore you, O true God! I praise you in the holy Temple of Israel.
verses.23: I will sing praises to You, for You have saved me from my troubles.
verses.24: Even today, your righteousness will be questioned, for those who seek evil will find it.
